$comment: Generated by scripts/preprocess-cmb.sh (scripts/cmb/polarisation.py). Do not edit by hand.
rows: bottom-up (v = 0 is the south galactic pole), texel for texel the grid of the temperature texture (cmb.json)
format: R8_UNORM, linear, zstd level 19 supercompression (lossless), box-filtered mip chain
encoding: line x = (255 s - 128) / 127 in -1..1 (stored in steps of 1/7), s the sampled value: 0 (code 128) is no line (masked, or too little polarisation); negative is a line, -1 its darkest. Lines run along the direction of polarisation.
shows: The direction of polarisation of the CMB as evenly spaced streamlines along it (Jobard & Lefer 1997): the directions are measured; where the lines start, and how far apart they are, is not.
convention: IAU: psi = 1/2 atan2(U_IAU, Q) from Galactic north through east, with U_IAU = -U of the file (POLCCONV = 'COSMO').

filter.description: E modes only (B set to zero), each multipole weighted by the Wiener factor S/(S+N) from the maps' own spectra (N = B-mode power, S = E - N, running mean over 11 multipoles), a cosine high-pass from ell 20 to 30 and a Gaussian low-pass of FWHM 3.0 deg.

mask.apodisation: 0 inside, cosine rise over 4.0 deg from the edge (holes included), at NSIDE 256

lines.seeds: beside the lines drawn so far, then a HEALPix NSIDE 128 grid shuffled with seed 20150204
lines.opacity: the apodised mask times a smoothstep from 0.15 to 0.4 of the median filtered polarisation (0.0927 uK); lines stop below 0.1

stack.description: radial polarisation (uK; positive radial, negative tangential) in the bins nearest 0.6 and 1.2 degrees. Expected: hot spots tangential at 0.6 and radial at 1.2; cold spots the reverse (Komatsu et al. 2011, section 7; Planck 2015 results XVI, section 8). The COSMO-sign control (U not converted, the same as a mirrored longitude) must lose the rings.

orientation.description: mean cos 2(angle between the lines measured in the texture and the field's direction) over texels with full contrast within 75 degrees of the Galactic equator: 1 = parallel everywhere, 0 = unrelated. The control reads longitude the other way round (the mirror).
